name: cfg-tools-web-search-fields
about: tools.webSearch 里还没比过的键（pilot/config/parseToolsConfig.ts:163-300、tool/builtin/webSearch.ts:333-347,860-868）：customProvider.sourceField / publishedAtField 指到结果项里的字段路径，看 web_search 结果里的 source / publishedAt；已移除的 region / tavilyApiKey 只给警告 TOOLS_WEB_SEARCH_REGION_DEPRECATED / TOOLS_WEB_SEARCH_TAVILY_KEY_DEPRECATED（resolve_settings 的 diagnostics 与配置快照）；再用 serve 起三份配置：两个字段都不写（缺省 source / publishedAt，快照里没有这两个键）、sourceField 不是字符串、publishedAtField 是空白串（TOOLS_WEB_SEARCH_CUSTOM_STRING_INVALID，致命）。
config:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  model: bbx/deterministic
  maxContextTokens: 65536
  maxOutputTokens: 8192
model:
  providers:
    bbx:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        deterministic:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
telemetry:
  enabled: false
tools:
  webSearch:
    enabled: true
    provider: custom
    endpoint: {MOCK}/search
    apiKey: search-key
    region: us
    tavilyApiKey: tvly-legacy
    customProvider:
      name: BBX Search
      method: POST
      queryParam: q
      resultsPath: choices
      titleField: finish_reason
      urlField: index
      snippetField: message.content
      sourceField: message.role
      publishedAtField: finish_reason
